programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you’ve been around cars very much, you’ve heard the term “barn find”. It depicts that “diamond in the rough” vehicle that everybody wants to find. Stacey delves into the barn find phenomenon and unveils what could be the ultimate barn find… the lost Richard Petty Car! Follow the incredible story of the car that Richard and Maurice Petty built in their early days, that was then sold and disappeared for decades... only to be found by Stacey and returned to Richard Petty so it could take its rightful place in the Petty Museum. It’s gearhead archeology at its best, and you’ll only see it on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey hits the road to visit a GEARZNation member to see if he can lend a hand on his project. The owner is a 16-year-old kid and the subject is his ’96 Dodge pickup that’s looking a little rough from years of use and abuse. That quickly changes as Stacey jumps in to help give the truck a new face, and at the same time offers tips and tricks to breathe a breath of fresh air into the project. See what a difference some time, expertise, and a few parts can make on a beat up old truck! After that, Stacey takes a look at the amazing Moduline Cabinets, and digs into what makes them so great.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey shows you how to tackle the one restoration project that everybody dreams of doing one day... the frame off restoration! You’ll be surprised how simple a job like this can be if you follow his simple tips and tricks and plan the project out properly. In the world of high dollar builds, a simple frame off restoration can get you back on the road enjoying your car or truck and at a fraction of the price. But to get a grasp on how to do it, you have to see this show. After that, Stacey swaps some licks with recording artist Casey James who just happens to be a gearhead at heart… all here… all Gearz!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: So, you think you want some custom bumpers for your big ol’ truck? Stacey shows you how to find what you’re looking for in the aftermarket, and also how to fabricate and build your own custom mounts to make ‘em sit exactly where you want them. After that he digs into the history of the Sgt. Rock truck and how it is permanently connected to “the greatest generation”. But this truck isn’t just about WWII, as a special tailgate airbrushed by Mickey Harris reveals, It’s about the men and women that have sacrificed for the freedoms we enjoy today. This is one show that will have you waving the flag!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey hits the road to help out a Gearz Nation member with his ‘56 Corvette project. Since the guy really wants to drive the car, putting in a modern 5 or 6spd tranny would be really nice. But which one? Well, we not only answer that question, but also give the guy a little helping hand with the transmission too. If you’ve ever wished Stacey made house calls, this is the show to see. After that we take a look at some serious questions that people ask about becoming a tool dealer and if it’s really worth it. You wanted to know… we got the answers for you!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey dives into the world of the sleeper, by taking a non-descript ’73 Plymouth Satellite, and begins transforming it into a street pounding monster under the skin. Gone is the lethargic 318 engine and front suspension, and in its place Stacey begins fitting a new state of the art performance suspension. It you are into surprising people at stop lights and run-what-you-brung race nights, then a “Street Sweeper” just might be the sort of approach you want to take on your next project.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Street Sweeper is back! Stacey delves into just how many parts it takes to completely change the drivetrain and suspension on a classic muscle car. Accessories, transmission, overdrive, headers, the list may seem to go on forever, but it’s all about finding the right parts in the aftermarket, to build the car that YOU want. After that it’s off to the races to see if E3’s new top fuel spark plug can handle the pressure of competition. If you want to see the ins and outs of building a car, GEARZ is the show to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you could only do one upgrade on your vehicle, that would make the biggest impact on the looks and drivability, what would it be? Stacey answers that question by installing a Katzkin leather interior into a Jeep Compass, and showing that if you’ve got an open weekend and a few hundred bucks, you can do the same thing on your car or truck. After that, he jumps back onto the Street Sweeper project to lay out the interior and the rearend, and finally drop that huge Hemi into place. If you’ve ever thought it would be fun to build a sleeper car, this is one ’73 Plymouth Satellite that shows how it can be done!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey Preps the bed of the NAPA Perfect additions truck. From rolling out Herculiner to installing transfer tank, truck boxes, and even a combination generator/compressor, this big Ford begins its Perfect Additions transformation. He also throws in a wiring tech that will keep you from getting your wires crossed.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey tackles power gains at the air intake, modifies the computer and replaces the stock exhaust before addressing a 2” front-end suspension lift kit. He moves on to give the truck some extra height and support in the rear of the truck where payload weight can be a serious issue. After the suspension is in place, new wheels and tires bring the truck back down to the ground. Stacey also covers several tools that will help you get that old exhaust out from under your vehicle.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey leads the crew on a hunt for a junkyard Jaguar with a rare engine. Pin-striping legend Von Hot Rod comes to the GearZ studio and lays down some lines on a hot rod guitar. Need to repair or replace the door on your pick up? Stacey’s got a handle on that. A bed lifter system turns a four-man operation into a one-man show. And Stacey’s got a steering column that will keep Falcon owners between the lines. All this and more!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey tells the story of the legendary Cheetah and how that car was designed to beat Shelby’s famed Cobra. The GEARZ hunt for this iconic race car features the original ’63 Cheetah that Budd Clusserath drove 215 mph at Daytona in ‘64. But the story doesn’t end there, because Stacey gets his hands on a Cheetah Evolution and shows you how to build your own version of this tire shredding cat! After that, you’ll see Steering wheel options from Grant, a serpentine belt system from LMC Truck, and Wizard products to make your vehicle come alive, as well as a quick tip to get things rolling in your shop. All this and more on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Put A Heart In The Cat
programme.desc: Moving deeper into the build of the Cheetah Evolution, Stacey and the crew pull the skin off this cat and start putting in the guts. Overviews of suspension, steering, and brakes get this project up and running. Moving into the heart of this beast, Stacey shows us that good things do come in small packages—the LSX 454 small block is sure to get your pulse rate up. And once the transmission is mounted, look out! Headers follow, and this cat is almost ready to run. Stacey’s tool tech will give you a lift… all this and more on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: A road trip, an overview of the Cheetah interior including seat and dash installation, rear lights and a tool tech. The GearZ crew heads out on the prowl to visit a budding young mechanic with a passion for 4X4’s. Back in the garage, Stacey gets in tight with the Cheetah, installing seats and the dash. Selecting gauges and placement are discussed, an AC unit will help keep this cat cool, taillights are fitted, and the side pipes will give this Cheetah some growl! Stacey’s tool tech will keep your project on time and on budget. And Fast Orange cleans more than your hands. All this on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Auction cars and what you might really find out once the car is in your garage: suspension, brakes and electrical concerns. In the current fad of “flipping” cars for cash, Stacey takes on the good, bad, and ugly of a ’66 Biscayne that was bought at auction. Nice looking paint can’t hide the safety issues that are found once this car is put on the lift. From suspension, to brakes, to battery cables… and even down to the lug nuts, this auction beauty turns out to be more of a beast. Safety and sport-style handling are only a few repairs away this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey and the crew head north to celebrate 40 years of Heartthrob Exhaust and see just how far this company has come since its modest beginnings in a garage. After that we dig into a cracked dash and show how easy it is to replace one yourself with some aftermarket parts from LMC Truck, and then we look at a painless solution will help clean up years of spliced wires and old electrical tape that might be lurking under your hood. It’s simple gearhead stuff that everybody needs to know and it’s only on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey digs back into the Cheetah project by finishing up the stance with custom wheels and tires, and then goes through the ins and outs of putting a classic Hilborn fuel injection on a modern LS engine… and the dyno numbers show that the engine likes it as much as you will! After that Stacey sits down with a budding car designer that is making a big impact everywhere he goes and there’s also a tip on the importance of seals and gaskets. It’s all about getting out and turning wrenches, and you’re only gonna find it on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey explores the history of the legendary Jaguar D-type racecar and introduces a D-type Jag from Race Car Replicas that is sure to become a legend of its own. From race wheels to classic spoke wheels with true knock-offs, Stacey looks at options for getting the best look and most rubber on the road with this Jag. A tip might keep you from losing your mind when dealing with lug nuts that don’t want to budge and we talk shop about performance parts for your own cars. So, come hang out while we take on a legendary cat of a different color this week on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey and the crew hit the ground running with a late model replacement bed from LMC that’s sure to revive and old Ford farm truck and get it out of the pastures and back on the highway. Then it’s off to show budding Jeep enthusiasts a couple of entry level options they can use when it comes to modifying their vehicle. We get a visit from a couple who learn how to install new seat upholstery. Stacey’s found something cool for all you second generation Camaro owners. And we’re just getting started! So get ready to turn some wrenches on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The GearZ crew and Cornwell Tools team up to help a new shop in Arkansas get some much-needed tools to help them take they’re shop the next level. Then Stacey puts together the final pieces of the Sgt. Rock project by making a trip to France and the beaches of Normandy. Then it’s back to the shop to show you how easy it is to put fuel injection on your muscle car. It’s all here… and only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Season 10 Starts off with America’s favorite military tribute truck! Sgt. Rock is back and ready for final assembly! Garage Guru, Stacey David, takes us on a tour de force of custom fabrication as he covers all the nuts and bolts of what it’s taken to get Sgt. Rock ready to rumble. Builders of all levels are in for a great show as Stacey tackles one of a kind steering columns, gas pedals and designing a console that not only fits form, but also function. Gauge techs will keep your instrument panels in line. And a quick tip will keep your wires from fraying and your hoses from splitting. All this and more as Sgt. Rock and Season 10 hit the road full throttle.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: A custom build can lose some power if the theme doesn’t stay consistent. Stacey shows how to do that by taking you through the process of how to make door and kick panels that keep the rugged military WWII bomber vibe flowing throughout the interior of Sgt. Rock. After that, its some tips on how to fit a radiator and that all-important cooling fan in a place where space is limited. Finally, the gas tank and battery placement are critical on a custom vehicle and Stacey goes through the steps in doing that as well. If you’ve always wanted to build a custom vehicle, this episode is sure to get your fabrication gearZ turning.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Two things are certain in life: death and taxes. We all know what to do with taxes, but what happens when a loved one passes and leaves behind an unfinished project vehicle? How do you know what’s sitting in your garage? And how can you find out? Stacey tackles these questions and takes you on a thorough inventory of an almost finished restoration that was left to a widow when her husband suddenly died. A new dash going into your vehicle? A gauge tech should keep you from crossing your wires. And we’ve got tips that should help with battery relocation and lining up your vehicle’s body panels.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Gearz On The Road - Basic Tools
programme.desc: The GearZ crew mount up and head out to visit a young gear-head whose love of wrenching started with 4-wheelers and has grown to include 4-wheel drive pick ups. Young Adam has a few surprises in store as Stacey visits him in his Dad’s garage and discusses tools, storage and tearing apart things to see how they work. Then, it’s back in the shop as Stacey takes on the big question every gear-head has: What OTHER tools should I have in my box? A look beyond the typical wrenches, hammers and clamps will show you what you may need and what you may not, depending on your project.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cheetah Body Work Latches Custom Exhaust
programme.desc: The son of legendary car builder, Bill Thomas, talks shop about wrenching, racing and his father’s Cobra Killer…the Cheetah. Then Stacey heads over to Stainless Works to check out how the Cheetah’s custom side pipes, headers and mufflers came together. A Gauge Tech explains the pros and cons of mechanical vs. electric gauges. After that, a Quick Tip explains the proper way to use some of those mystery tools laying around in your tool box.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Ever wonder why your wife or best buddy won’t step foot in your late model truck? It could be that crusty interior. Tag along as Stacey takes on the sights and smells of an ’83 Chevy in dire need of some attention. From new dash to leather on the bench seat and new carpet in the floor, Stacey shows you what a difference a weekend and some parts from LMC can make. Speaking of trucks, Stacey raises the bar with a bed lifter that will make you the most popular guy in your neighborhood. A new buffer is going to help add some shine to your vehicle and a creeper that’s simply “Magic” is sure to raise an eyebrow or two. Big things are happening in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Through the years, we’ve had some amazing vehicles featured on GearZ—from elite racecars to the insanity of a V-8 barstool. Well, here we go again! Stacey hauls in a Thiokol Imp that needs some…attention. First things first with this crazy snowcatmobile; we’ve got to see if we can make it run. Follow along as Stacey takes you through the ins and outs of getting a neglected vehicle up and running again. For you performance BMW guys, a tuner from Dinan is going add the horses you’ve been looking for. We’ve got sparks flying, fuel splashing and all kinds of garage mayhem this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: In the world of car building there are few things more ominous than missing titles or VIN numbers. But there is one task that stands out, one that brings grown men to tears, one that is usually lurking behind 100 yards of electrical tape…WIRING. Well hold on tight as Stacey dives head first into wiring Sergeant Rock. That’s right; see how painless Stacey can make wiring the big old truck. Follow along as Stacey moves front to back and gets the Rock one step closer to hitting the road!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With summer in full swing, it’s time to cool down that classic truck of yours. That’s right, roll those windows up and feel the cool breeze as Stacey shows just how easy it is to install this complete AC system from LMC Truck. Now that you’re done sweatin’, let’s take a look at headers and intakes and get that motor performing the way it should. And don’t miss out on the ins and outs of turbos and super-chargers…which one fits your needs? All this and plenty of sparks in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey and the GearZ crew heat things up as they head to the Cornwell forges to watch molten steel be expertly transformed into America’s best ratchet. Get ready to see sparks fly. But the trip doesn’t stop there. Tag along as the crew follows what it takes for a ratchet to end up on a Cornwell truck. Back in the garage, Stacey talks maximizing boost and the role of intercoolers when it comes to super-chargers and turbos. The wheels keep turning and the rubber keeps burning, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Cheetah lovers will be excited to see Stacey’s solution to keeping the headers both cool and looking red hot. Want to keep using your stock tank after converting to fuel injection? Get psyched, because Holley has a new fuel pump that’s going to make your life a whole lot easier. Think your car is buttoned up tight? Stacey and some friends from Redline Detection blow smoke at the old soap and water test and show you how to really test for leaks in your vehicle. It’s a world of problems out there, but Stacey’s got you covered in the garage. All this and more, this week, on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This week Stacey and crew head to Memphis, TN to help out a local BBQ pitmaster who’s deep into a ground up rebuild of a ’72 Nova. The big challenge here?...Can you swap out an automatic transmission with a manual without losing your mind? Well, Stacey is always up for a good challenge and he’ll show you just how simple this swap can be. A new tuner from Super chips will make your Jeep life easier, and replacement dashes for Chevy owners are going to light up their eyes. There’s a lot going on in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cheap Fuel Injection Snow Cat Bed TN Electric Guitar
programme.desc: We’re winding up the tenth season of GearZ, and what a season it’s been! But we’ve got some business to take care of before we move onto season eleven. First things first…Holley just made an EFI even easier to install on your carbureted vehicle, and Stacey will show you just how on target the Sniper is. The Thiokol Imp gets a suspension upgrade to keep it on track. And there’s a new kind of off-roading that’s sweeping the nation…see what RC4WD has going on. And what season would be complete without guitars? Check out Tennessee Electric Company as Stacey introduces a new guitar-maker whose custom guitars are hotter than the asphalt at the drag strip.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re back and taking it to the streets! Season 11 comes roaring back with a look at Super Lite Cars on the road and the track! Stacey recalls and earlier SLC build and introduces two SLC builders who took a very hands-on approach to putting their cars together. These street/race cars are sure to catch your eye and get your racing blood flowing. If there’s one thing Stacey preaches on every episode, it’s paying attention to the details. His quick tip is no exception, getting rid of those sharp edges and nasty welds to give your project the small details that people will notice. Side mirrors for a muscle car, building a better battery, and keeping your air flowing through carbon fiber vents fill out the parts bin. We’ve got all this and more as Stacey kicks of his 11th season of GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This is the moment you’ve been waiting for! Master car builder, Stacey David, shows off the truck that’s had the nation talking for ten years! Take a look back at the kid with the dream. Follow the design and fabrication. See what happens when the military tribute vehicle rolls out and conquers the road! This episode is gonna be epic. It’s been a long road, but anything worth doing well is worth the wait. This week, the wait is over. Sergeant Rock Lives!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: On the Road & Unicure Spray Booths
programme.desc: Things are rockin’ and rollin’ in and out of the GearZ garage. Stacey hits the road to find a project build that will get gear heads buzzing. He ends up with an ’81 Camaro and some awesome stories from the seller. If you’re talking project vehicles, you’ve got to talk paint! And Stacey does just that with folks from Unicure, who specialize in paint booths and helping you get set up for that all important paint job. The V-8 Interceptor is back from a trip to Stainless works, where a custom exhaust system was made for the big Boss Nine engine. Things are about to get loud, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: The Return of Heavy Metal & Snowcat
programme.desc: Stacey and the GearZ crew roll in an old favorite: Heavy Metal. The coolest hotrod tow truck is back in the garage and ready for a facelift. Our good friends at the Hot Rod Institute drop by and talk shop with Stacey about his plans for the paint and fab work needed to get this bad boy looking good and back on the road. Fresh from the sandblaster, the snowcat reveals the scars that were under the skin. And with the drive train out, Stacey walks through the importance of replacing gaskets, seals and checking for wear and tear before stuffing that engine, transmission and skid steer rear end back into the cat. There’s a whole lot going on this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Every gear head has a secret: they all want to drive like McQueen in Bullitt, or Vin Diesel in The Fast And The Furious. But when the heat gets turned up, even some really good drivers can’t keep up. That’s when you bring in the Stunt Double! This week Stacey sits down with legendary Hollywood stunt man Ian Quinn to talk crashing cars and keeping actors out of harms way. There’s also a new project in the garage: The Stunt Double, a build inspired by the 80’s tv show The Fall Guy, and sure to get all four wheels off the ground before Stacey’s done with it. Sparks are going to fly and you know we’re gonna have a good time this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Seems like you can’t go more than a block these days without running into someone whose had some work done on their face. Well, here at the GearZ garage, Stacey believes in facelifts too. Just to prove it, he’s taken on a 1981 Camaro and sharpened his scalpel to perform an automotive nose job. Just wait till you see him whack of the old rubber nose and replace it with a 71’ rally sport front end! Now that’s what we call a facelift. Plenty of people said it couldn’t be done, but that’s just the kind of challenge Stacey is up for. Plenty of sparks are gonna fly, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: They say that true change comes from within… Well, this week Stacey turns his attention to the interior of the Stunt Double. The old, crusty junk hits the floor and our Fall Guy inspired build gets a new look: from painting trim and door panels, to a new bench seat. Man o’ man, this truck is starting to look completely different. A shower of sparks lights up the garage as Stacey demonstrates how to make a bracket that mounts our new bench seat to the truck while using the stock seat adjustment. It’s a tour de force of aftermarket parts and salvaging what we’ve got, this week on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When you’re putting together a project that’s inspired by a high-flying stunt truck, you know you’ve got to add some lift, and our Stunt Double gets the goods this week. The front and rear suspension get treated to a 6” lift to get that rig up in the air. But a good lift won’t do any good if the steering and frame can’t hold up, so Stacey shows you how Offroad Design has fixed some serious issues that many late model four-wheel drives encounter. Bed need to come off your truck, but the carriage bolts are rusted and spinning? Stacey’s got a fix for that too. There’s a lot going on, and we’ve got you covered, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everyone needs a little boost here and there. For some people, coffee does the trick. But here in the GearZ Garage we take our boost seriously. And we like ours packing 160 HP. Hang on to your seat as Stacey adds a bolt on Supercharger to a Ram 1500 breathes a little excitement into a daily driver. And speaking of things going on in the garage, you’ll definitely want to stick around as Stacey talks shop with the guys at Rebuilding Generations. Learn all about how this mentoring program is teaching the next generation about working on cars and sharing plenty of life lessons. We’ve got a lot going on this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re running full steam ahead as the Stunt Double rolls back into the shop this week! First, Stacey reveals the wheels and tires that are going to accentuate that 6” lift, then He dives headlong into the drivetrain of this beast and comes up with a hot crate engine and a high-performance transmission to get the Stunt Double ready for the road. But that’s not all…. We also take some time out for a visit with the guys from American Powertrain and so much more. Check out the sparks flying in the garage this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s business as usual in the garage this week. We’re back at work on the Catalog Camaro and really diggin’ into the front end. You know what they say, “out with the old and in with the new,” and that’s exactly what Stacey’s doing. The old sub frame, drivetrain, and suspension are hitting the garage floor in favor of a much-needed updated suspension system that’ll keep this awesome Camaro hugging the road at high speeds—From the wheels to the sub frame, Stacey’s replacing it all. And he’s not going to break the bank while doing it, either. Follow the GearZ crew as they hit the road and visit Cornwell Tools to see their latest and greatest tool box being manufactured. From powder coat to knuckle bustin’ bolts, we’ve got you covered this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We head out of the garage to visit one of the premiere supercharger manufacturers in the world… ATI Pro Charger. Follow along for the ride as Stacey walks through the entire process of how they have raised the bar on how a supercharger is built and what it does. From bulk metal to dyno runs, we’ve got it covered. Back in the garage, a young Gearhead drops by to learn how to install an air intake and cowl induction hood on his pick-up. After the wrench turning is done, he and Stacey have enough time to hit a few licks on their guitars. From massive horsepower increases with state-of-the-art tools and machinery, to simple intake and hood installs,….. it’s all here, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey is in full hot rod mode as he unveils a wicked LS engine and Tremec 6spd tranny and stuffs it into the Catalog Camaro. If 600hp and a 6spd in a Camaro doesn’t get you going, the update on the Stunt Double will! It’s old school cool as Stacey shows off the stainless light bar, side steps and cutout flairs to give the truck that “Fall Guy” vibe. After that we introduce you to the amazing world of scale R/C that is sure to have you re-thinking what you want for Christmas! Finally we roll in some updates on the Cheetah and the Junkyard Jag too. If you’re a gearhead, you’re gonna find a whole lot to love about this show!......and that’s GEARZ!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Season 12 opens with bang as Stacey starts the final assembly process on the V8 Interceptor. If you’ve ever wondered how to lay out an aftermarket A/C system, wiring harness, and steering column on your project… and make them all work together, you have to see this show! After that, NHRA legend and Hall-of-Famer, Doug Herbert drops by the GearZ garage to share the shocking story that inspired him to start the B.R.A.K.E.S. driving program. Hold on tight, because this ain't your typical high school driver's Ed. Program! If you want cool tech and awesome stories… you’re gonna find that on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about fabrication and thinking outside the box, or to be more specific... outside the bed! Sure, sure, there are plenty of custom pick-up truck beds you can buy but Stacey shows you what is involved in MAKING a custom bed to fit any vehicle, even something as crazy as a Thiokol Imp snowcat! That's right… our little snowcat is back from the sand blaster and ready for a cool bed to match the cab. Stacey goes in-depth about sizing up the project, picking the right parts, and most importantly: how to cut, weld, grind and finish sheet metal to get a bed that will fit your unique vehicle like a glove. So grab a welder… it’s time to make your bed!... only on GearZ.

Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. - He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. - Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. - Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. - What happens when these two meet?

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When the fully tattooed yakuza criminal Samejima finds a girl he likes, he kidnaps them, drugs them up, and then roughs them up. Fumino was happy. She had a job and a fiance. But one night, Samejima sets his sights on her, and has his men kidnap her. Fumino manages to escape, and runs to her fiance Satoru's house, but Samejima is in hot pursuit. Inuyashiki comes to save them, but gets shot.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. - Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami escaped from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree. With nowhere to go, Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities with Ando's help. After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. - One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The Accona Desert and Sense Clays
programme.desc: The Marquisate was still able to maintain its core identity, and gave birth to a rich local culture; this spirit exists in the Rocca of Castellar; in the Castello of Manta, with the fresco cycle of the Nine Worthies in the Baronial Hall.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: Terra del Sole and Tuscan Romagna
programme.desc: The Accona desert in the heart of the Tuscan countryside, with artwork along the Via Francigena including its multiple frescoes.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The Brenta Canal and Venetian Villas
programme.desc: Connecting Padua and Venice, the Brenta Riviera boasts many Venetian Villas built between the 15th and 18th Century after the discovery of America began to render local maritime trade less important.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The Duchy of Amalfi and the Amalfi Coast
programme.desc: Founded when the people of Amalfi freed themselves from the reigning Lombards in the Principality of Benevento. We travel back in time to the election of their first local aristocratic dukes via a visit to the church of Saint Salvatore de Birecto. We learn more about the history of the region in the Chronicon Salernitanum and take a look at Raphael's painting 'The Battle of Ostia'.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The State of the Presidi and the Maremma
programme.desc: The State of the Presidi is a swampy, malarial land, which, thanks only to human resilience and intelligence, became a centre of wealth and culture. The journey starts from the Metalliferous Hills of Maremma, rich in raw metals and the historical capital of mining territory, and continues to the historical buildings and the ancient water springs of Massa Maratima with its famous Fertility Tree.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The history of the Duchy of Urbino is really the history of two families: the Montefeltros and the Della Roveres, nobles and patrons who bid for everlasting fame with architectural and artistic works. Their efforts resulted in the painting The Flagellation of Christ, the rooms of the Ducal Palace, the Guest apartment with the King Of England's Room, the Throne Room and the Chapel of Guidubaldo.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Situated between the Alps in France and the duchy of Savoy, and influenced by both regions, the Marquisate was still able to maintain its core identity, and gave birth to a rich local culture. This spirit exists in the Rocca of Castellar; in the Castello of Manta, with the fresco cycle of the Nine Worthies in the Baronial Hall or the painting of the Madonna del Latte in the church of Santa Maria.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The Borromean Islansa and Isola Bella
programme.desc: It took almost 400 years and the work of hundreds of highly qualified architects, engineers, plasterers, painters, and woodworkers who all contributed to the transformation of the Isola Bella. Up until 1630 the Isola Bella was only a rocky crag occupied by a few fishermen, two small churches and a few unassuming gardens. At the turn of the 17th century the House of Borromeo initiated change.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: According to mythology, Anagni was established by Saturn himself in an area surrounded by huge calcareous walls. Historically, we know that the town was conquered by the Roman Empire at the beginning of the IV century B.C. Even though it was influenced by the Holy See, during the Middle Age Anagni was a free town where two families, the Caetanis and the Colonnas, fought hard for supremacy.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1693, an unprecedented earthquake hit the Valley of Noto destroying several small towns such as Modica, Ragusa and Scicli, which were all included in the Norman Kingdom of Sicili. More than 90,000 lives were lost. Giuseppe Lanza, the Spanish appointed viceroy, took charge of the reconstruction of the area. He called on Sicilian architects Giovanni Baptista, Vaccarini and Rosario Gagliardi.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: The county of Soleto was founded in 1055: the Norman Robert Guiscard of Hauteville conquered the rusty lands of Southern Salento and entrusted Earl Orsini with them. Soleto can now boast the only remaining legacy of the region's Norman age: the 'Guglia di Raimondello' the striking bell tower which is considered one of the finest examples of Apulian gothic style.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: Caprarola and the Duchy of Castro
programme.desc: The duchy of Castro was founded in 1537 by Pope Paul III, Alessandro Farnese, who wanted to donate the area to his son Pier Luigi. The dukedom includes not only Ischia di Castro, the capital city that was destroyed in 1649 by the Papal troops, but also Valentano and Capodimonte where you can still admire the amazing palaces of the Farnese family...

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Before crossing the Alps and visiting the Ambras castle, the Imperial Palace, the cathedral and the Tyrolean State Museum, it is important to understand the origins of Tyrol. Beginning in the XII century, in the mountains of Alto Adige. We travel along the Inn and the Adige rivers to the entrance of the Vinschgau Valley, before visiting Tyrol Castle, and the city of Merano.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 35: El Viaje de los Celos Desatados
programme.desc: Salvador cree que Josefina se dio cuenta de que él está enamorado de Socorro y trata de darle explicaciones, pero ella por el contrario está convencida de que él está profundamente enamorado de ella. Salvador no la contradice, pero acuerdan no volver a tener contacto sexual, para evitar confusiones. Agustina le propone a Socorro que descanse un rato en su casa de campo con Salvador para que la cuide y se alejen de los secuestradores. Socorro no entiende nada, pero acepta y le dice a Salvador quien accede a acompañarla sin siquiera pensarlo. Salvador les cuenta a Josefina y Mercedes para que no le pongan problemas. Las dos lo escuchan, pero se mueren de celos.

programme.title: Episodio 35: Marisela acusa, Ricardo esconde la verdad
programme.desc: Cuando Marisela acusa a Gabriel de no querer que su marido se cure, tanto Gabriel como Arelys tratan de hacerle comprender su error, pero ella desesperada sigue haciendo la misma afirmación. Abril se niega a atender a Alfonso Malavé cuando éste llama a su negocio, dice que todo a su tiempo se hará y Alfonso se enfurece, pero trata de calmarse diciéndose que Brillante es muy poca cosa para hacerlo molestar. Moncho no sabe como hacer que Gabriela se marche sin comprometer demasiado a Ricardo pero ésta le ayuda completando de algún modo la información que necesita y termina marchándose para la clínica de su padre. En tanto que Ricardo no encuentra que hacer para que Isadora no entre a la habitación donde se encuentra su padre para que no descubra la realidad de su vida.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 78: El Anillo Roto y Secretos Revelados
programme.desc: Dileidi comparte un momento con Aureliano en la platabanda, no esta dispuesta a seguir llorando por Luis Fernando, aunque Aureliano no le cree mucho, se toman unas cervezas, conversan y hasta bailan, el sabe que es difícil que ella lo ame pero se conforma, por lo menos esta con el, aunque piense en el otro. Otro que no deja de pensar es Luis Fernando, tiene la compañía de la miss, quien de paso se da cuenta que su profe papi lo que tiene es tremendo despecho y las otras dos que le brincan de un lado a otro, se lamentan de que se haya aparecido con ese mujeron opacándolas a ellas, bueno en realidad opacando a todo el mundo, pero el continua sumergido en el recuerdo de Dileidi. Los que la están pasando de lo mejor son Santiago y Eglee, también baila, ella canta y en un momento que se ponen a convensar Santiago le besa la mano y sin querer o sin habérselo propuesto le saca el anillo que por tanto tiempo y después de tantos intentos fallidos ella trataba de sacarlo, el lo logro, Eglee se alegra ahora si es verdad que tiene otro motivo para ser otra persona, ya no hay anillos que le recuerden a Rómulo. En la boda están sentadas la Nena quien esta pensando en que estado podría estar Eglee, Theo hace de las suyas se luce con todo el mundo y por supuesto todo el mundo se ríe de el, bueno no todo el mundo por que la Nena solo pasa pena con cada ocurrencia de su Doroteo, bueno otras que están en la mesa son Pascuita y Matilde, que no hay tema de conversación que puedan llevar sin tener que discutir, una cree que es injusto lo que le pasa a Eglee, la otra no pues por que al final ella fue la que decidió divorciarse, el grupo el son desafinado se prepara para tocar ante los presentes, Rómulo en esta oportunidad no cantará canciones de los Beatles sino que tocarán algo de su autoría, Betzaida que esta pendiente de todo, toma el detalle de la letra de la canción y entiende que esa canción no es para ella, si no para Eglee, su mamá trata de convencerla de lo contrario, pero ya el daño esta hecho, cuando terminan de cantar sus compañeros de banda, le sugieren a Rómulo que después de haber metido la pata con esa canción ahora le toca arreglar la cosa, pues todo fue muy obvio. Mientras tanto Eglee la sigue pasando de lo mejor con su muchachito, le encanta la manera que tiene de besar, después suben a la habitación de ella, pero dentro de todo ella esta clara que hay demasiado de Rómulo aún allí como para estar con alguien que no sea el, le pide a Santiago que se la lleve de ahí, el accede a complacer a la mujer de sus sueños, de la que ha estado enamorado en silencio desde hace tiempo ya. Luis Fernando trata de distraerse con María Gracia pero las otras dos lo interrumpen a cada rato, luego se ponen hablar las tres de que si están gordas o no, nada de importancia, y vuelve a recordar a su Dileidi con la que si le provocaba tener una conversación de verdad, una mujer inteligente que era capaz de entenderlo, luego vuelve a resignarse, y cree que algo debe salir de esas tres mujeres. Gladis le da la buena noticia a su hijo Aleisi de que tendrá una audición en la orquesta, Gerson cree que con la tremenda palanca que tiene su mamá le darán el puesto a su hermano así no sepa nada, esta Gladis diciendo que ella esta muy agradecida con Marco Aurelio por haberle hecho ese favor y en ese momento entra Gabriel que escucha a Gladis y sin pensarlo le reclama que el también la ha ayudado y sin embargo a el no le agradece nada, también le dice en tono molesto que la vio bajarse de la camioneta del doctor, Gladis que no es tonta se da cuenta que su amigo esta bravo, manda a sus hijos para la pieza y una vez a solar, se las canta toditas, ella no tiene que darle cuenta a nadie de lo que haga o deje de hacer, para eso ella se mantiene, y es la dueña de su casa, de sus hijos y de ella misma, o sea que el pobre Gabito se quedo sorprendido con la actitud de Gladis, el sabe que esa es una mujer de armas tomar. Ya betzaida se quiere estrenar como la señora de Rómulo, pero el no tiene interés en dejar a los invitados, ella le dice que no se preocupe que su mamá se encarga de todo, que se vayan ya, el indiscreto de Theo se les acerca y le da a Rómulo un preservativo y le dice que la pastillita se la queda debiendo, ya la Nena no aguanta mas vergüenza, es como mucho para una sola noche. Otras que casi termina la fiesta son Matilde y Pascuita quienes una vez mas se enfrascaron en una discusión y esta vez fue delante de sus maridos, solo que Ramón saco a bailar a su mujer mientras que Matilde le dice a Gonzalo que ya no aguanta la prepotencia con que Pascuita la trata, que se expresa muy mal de su marido, parece que a Gonzalo no le gusto nada haber escuchado a su esposa ponerse a defender a Ramón. Ernesto y Alegría están de acuerdo que el matrimonio no sirve para nada, ellos hablan en base a las experiencias de sus padres y no les parece que valga la pena casarse, Rosita los aconseja de lo contrario. Mientras su marido habla con Nely que al identificarlo le recuerda que ellos fueron novios cuando eran jóvenes. Santiago lleva a Eglee a su apartamento, allá le confiesa que ella es la primera mujer que entra al apartamento, ella le encuentra una foto y el le confiesa que la quiere desde hace mucho tiempo atrás, que la foto se la robo a Luis Fernando.

programme.title: Episodio 23: El Secreto de Inés/Sasha Revelado
programme.desc: Diego descubre quien es Sasha y se lo hace saber a Inés, quien en un principio lo niega, pero luego l e explica que él como psiquiatra ha analizado su personalidad y ha detectado su doble actividad. Gabriela habla con Luis y le dice que debe botar a Inés de la casa pero él le recuerda que es la esposa de su hermano. Diego continúa insistiendo con Inés para mantenga clara cual es su personalidad y no la confunda con su doble vida a la vez que ella le pide que le prometa que no dirá nada de su situación a nadie. Diego le advierte que tenga mucho cuidado con Robert quien es una persona muy astuta y peligrosa. Berta va a visitar a Solbella y le pregunta si Armando tiene alguna aventura en el club, pero ella le garantiza que no.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril y Vicenta dan a luz en el mismo lugar y al mismo tiempo. La enfermera confunde los bebés, entregando a cada madre el hijo de la otra. Ellas, mediante su instinto, se dan cuenta de esto y deciden, por su cuenta, visitarse una a la otra para intentar solucionar este problema. Una jueza le da la custodia de Neta a Helda, justificándose en que es la única figura materna que tiene presente. Sin embargo, en un acto de injusticia, le permite a la chica vivir junto a su abuela en la mansión Humboldt, y le sugiere a Inmaculada que se mude, ya que ella es la que sobra. La viuda negra amenaza a Vanesa y quiere que mate a Ivana. Si ella no lo hace, su hija Julie está en peligro, razón por la cual Vanesa está muy nerviosa y perturbada.

La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 31: Peligro y secretos antes de la luna de miel
programme.desc: Isadora confunde el reclamo de Gabriel piensa que su marido descubrió su engaño y cuando éste le hace saber que solo se trata del cambio que hay en la casa se siente más tranquila. Celine se niega a darle el sobre con los resultados de los exámenes de Chucho a Marisela y le recuerda que sólo podrá saber que dicen después que el doctor Anselmo lo autorice. Chucho celebra con sus hijos por la luna de miel que está a punto de emprender con Marisela y se asusta mucho cuando las piernas le fallan y ruega a dios para que nada se interponga en sus planes con su mujer.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 32: Marisela Ruega Olvidar a Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le pide a Marisela que no se marche con Jesús de luna de miel pero ella se niega a oírlo mientras que Isadora que está oyendo la conversación se enfurece porque ella lo está despreciando y tiene que colgar el teléfono porque Gabriela llega llorando y exigiéndole que bote a Aurora de la casa por ser una metiche. Gabriel está furioso porque Marisela lo desengaña nuevamente y termina enfrentándose a Aurora reclamando por su hija. Ricardo y Daniel discuten por el teléfono y Jesús no les hace caso porque solo piensa en su viaje del día siguiente. Marisela en la capilla de la clínica ruega a la virgen para que la ayude a ser buena madre y a olvidar a Gabriel para poder amar a Jesús

programme.title: Episodio 33: La carta, el escape y el profesor
programme.desc: Chucho está feliz porque tiene a Marisela para si solo en la Colonia Tovar y a punto de iniciar su luna de miel, pero Marisela está muy asustada. Gabriel está desesperado en la casa de Marisela se niegan a decirle donde se encuentra ella y su esposo y no sabe que hacer y Moncho finalmente lo alcanza en la calle y le suministra la dirección del hotel donde se encuentra la pareja. Ricardo está muy triste tiene que darle la carta a Gabriela donde le cuenta la verdad de su vida y sabe que probablemente la pierda pero la carta le es arrebatada por los otros compañeros de clases que se burlan mientras se pasan la carta unos a otros y finalmente Giancarlos como venganza se la entrega al profesor.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 34: Jesus golpea a Gabriel y Marisela
programme.desc: Jesús cuando oye a Gabriel gritando su nombre en la puerta, sale como enloquecido y comienza a golpearlo tratando de hacerlo marcharse, pero éste sigue allí impertérrito diciéndole lo mismo, que es necesario que se marchen a la clínica porque él está muy enfermo. Marisela trata de apaciguar la situación e intercede ante Jesús para que no siga golpeando a Gabriel y Jesús arremete en contra de ella, hasta que llegan los empleados del hotel que se hacen cargo de la situación e intentan tranquilizar tanto a Jesús como al resto de los huéspedes que están molestos con el escándalo.

programme.title: Episodio 35: Marisela acusa, Ricardo esconde la verdad
programme.desc: Cuando Marisela acusa a Gabriel de no querer que su marido se cure, tanto Gabriel como Arelys tratan de hacerle comprender su error, pero ella desesperada sigue haciendo la misma afirmación. Abril se niega a atender a Alfonso Malavé cuando éste llama a su negocio, dice que todo a su tiempo se hará y Alfonso se enfurece, pero trata de calmarse diciéndose que Brillante es muy poca cosa para hacerlo molestar. Moncho no sabe como hacer que Gabriela se marche sin comprometer demasiado a Ricardo pero ésta le ayuda completando de algún modo la información que necesita y termina marchándose para la clínica de su padre. En tanto que Ricardo no encuentra que hacer para que Isadora no entre a la habitación donde se encuentra su padre para que no descubra la realidad de su vida.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 19: Ines, profuga, busca refugio y ayuda.
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo irrumpe en la casa de marta helena presionando a esta para que le indique el paradero de Inés tras haberse percatado de su ausencia, la policía llega a la casa de marta Helena siguiendo las pistas del paradero de Inés quien tras haber sido denunciada por Gabriela se haya prófuga de la justicia. Inés recurre a la ayuda de Solbella viéndose sin lugar a donde pasar la noche. Daniela conversa con Chela sintiéndose intrigada por el contenido del sobre que esta tiene en su poder. Robert disuelve las intenciones de Chela al apoderarse del sobre contentivo de las fotografías de Sacha. Inés se oculta de Luis Guillermo quien la busca incesablemente.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 20: Robert oculta a Ines de Reina
programme.desc: En la casa de Solbella Inés se ve sorprendida por presencia de Robert quien la confunde con Reina por estar en su habitación. Luis Guillermo vigila los pasos de Robert al sospechara este protegiendo a Inés. Robert conversa con Inés intentando explicar su presencia, Reina los interrumpe con su llegada apresurando a Robert a mantener la presencia de Inés oculta ante ella. Solbella tranquiliza a Inés quien se preocupa al percatarse de la vigilia que Luis Guillermo mantiene en el edificio. Luis Guillermo observa la salida de Robert y Reina del edificio. Tras su salida del restaurante Diego Andrés conduce a Carolina hasta su casa aprovechando la ocasión de hacer remembranzas de su época de estudiantes. Michelle espera impaciente la llegada de Diego Andrés.

programme.title: Episodio 21: Celos, Confesión y Planes de Matrimonio
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo se enfrenta a Robert sintiéndose celos del creciente interés que este manifiesta por Inés, Robert le aclara su posición al recordarle a Luis Guillermo la autosuficiencia de Inés al poder elegir su vida. Gabriela se ve obligada a reconocer su culpa ante la policía tras haber acusado a Inés de robo. En la cancha de tenis Debora percatada de la actitud de Luis Guillermo advierte a Daniela de su posible interés por Inés. Tras las dudas de Luis Guillermo Robert se ve obligado a confesarle sus planes de matrimonio con Inés. Asunta sintiéndose feliz por el regreso de Inés es testigo de su cambio de actitud al no permitirle a la familia Nuñez mas abusos en su contra. Luis Guillermo discute con Robert asegurándose de defender a Inés de sus intenciones.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 22: Luis Guillermo quiere irse y necesita dinero
programme.desc: Inés, muy preocupada, baja las escaleras de la mansión de los Nuñez preguntando a la Ama de Llaves Asunta, que quién había entrado en su habitación. En ese momento entra Luis Guillermo indicándole a Inés que deseaba hablar con ella. El tema de conversación era que él deseaba irse de la casa ya que en los últimos días esa casa tenía demasiados problemas y él creía que uno de los principales problemas era él. Que deseaba trabajar y apartarse de todo. Inés le indica que para eso no necesita mudarse de la casa, ya que siendo él el hermano mayor de los Nuñez, le correspondía vivir en la mansión. Luis Guillermo le dice a Inés que no se queda y que necesita dinero para mudarse. En otro escenario están Daniela y Debora.

programme.desc: Om es un súper comando que tiene la importante misión de devolver al Rashtra Kavach (que literalmente se traduce como guardia de seguridad del país) a buenas manos y salvar la nación. Está a punto de completar su misión cuando recibe un disparo y vuelve a la vida solo para darse cuenta de que ha perdido la memoria. Mientras tanto, Kavya Sharma se ocupa de él mientras otros funcionarios de la agencia gubernamental de élite, Murthy y Jai Rathod, están ocupados pensando cómo hacer que Om regrese a la misión. Pero no es tan sencillo como parece desde fuera. Mientras salva a su nación, Om tiene mucho más por descubrir: por ejemplo, encontrar a su padre Dev Rathod y demostrar que no era un traidor.

programme.title: Proscrito
programme.desc: Un ex miembro del Royal Marine Commando descubre pruebas que podrían derribar a un funcionario corrupto y ponerlo tras las rejas de por vida. Cuando secuestran a su novia de la infancia, su misión es rescatarla y dejar que todo se interponga en su camino.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Francisca enfrenta a Ítalo. Ítalo la amenaza con entregarla a Patiño. Esteban sufre un infarto leve tras desmayarse al volante. Francisca, Domingo y Matías viajan a Bogotá para transportar droga. Esmeralda sale con Juan en México. Francisca y su familia huyen de sus captores en un retén militar. Pedro y Ambrosio planean asesinar a Homero en la basílica mexicana.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Fanny acepta salir con Ambrosio. Ambrosio advierte a Pedro posponer el asesinato, pero Pedro sigue con sus planes. Alejandro golpea a una prostituta y es denunciado. Octavio paga para silenciarla. Homero y su esposa sufren un atentado. Esteban descubre que el senador Almanza trabaja para “el jefe”. Esmeralda está a salvo en una clínica, y la policía planea usarla para atrapar a Homero.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Alicia le revela a Esteban que está embarazada. Francisca rescata a su hermano del campamento guerrillero. En México, Juan usa la situación de Esmeralda para obtener información sobre Homero. Ambrosio confiesa a su madre su implicación en el atentado, mientras Homero se reúne con el oficial Durán, encargado de la investigación.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Mientras huyen, Francisca y su familia caen en un campo minado. Los escándalos de Alejandro amenazan su papel en la telenovela, y José Miguel podría reemplazarlo. Francisca y los desplazados son ayudados por el capitán Ballesteros, quien les ofrece empezar de cero. Manrique es nombrado director de un programa de sustitución de cultivos. Francisca adopta una nueva identidad.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: La DIAN investiga a Alberto por recibir dineros ilícitos. En México, Ambrosio planea conquistar a Fanny para herir a su padre. José Miguel confiesa a Alejandro que es amante de Rubén y obtuvo el papel en la telenovela gracias a él. Alberto, sin ayuda de Esteban, presiona a Alicia, amenazando revelar su amorío y la verdadera paternidad de su hijo.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: La fiscalía investiga a Alberto por lavado de activos, Esteban interviene. “El tuerto” enfrenta a Esmeralda por Juan y revela sus vínculos con la policía. En Miami, la policía investiga la desaparición de Rubén. Esteban podría perder su curul por dineros ilícitos. Juan muere en un accidente. Rubén aparece muerto y Alejandro es sospechoso.

programme.title: La Ruta Blanca
programme.desc: Alberto es presionado por "el jefe" para asumir la responsabilidad de los dineros ilícitos en la campaña de Esteban. José Miguel revela un romance entre Alejandro y Rubén. Alberto se declara culpable en el caso de la campaña. Jeimy encuentra pruebas de la inocencia de Alejandro. Homero descubre que su contador está haciendo tratos con la policía.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Tras haber perdido el rastro de los fugitivos, Steve es capturado por la Policía por todos sus crímenes y corrupción, siendo destituido de su cargo. Esperanza empieza a vivir su vida en libertad con una serie de complicaciones, entre esos, conflictos con su compañera de cuarto, la cual insiste en hacerle la vida imposible. Ricardo busca la manera de deshacerse del cuerpo de Patricia.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Mariana, sintiéndose sola, inicia una relación con Ricardo. Esperanza busca a su amor y a su hija, y ambas buscan pruebas de la inocencia de Julián. Un atraco a su embarcación desata un conflicto mortal, exacerbado por los sentimientos de la joven hacia sus compañeros. Descubren una cámara oculta en un maletín. Ricardo y su hermano se enfrentan a muerte.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Vladímir, ahora Irina, se une a su madre, la bruja Tabaco, para derrotar a Ricardo, quien intenta expulsar a Mariana de la empresa. Julián y su equipo, tras salvar a una niña de un accidente de tren, buscan a Irina. Steve ofrece su ayuda a Esperanza, quien acepta y se muda con él.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Johnny traiciona a Steve, dejándolo en el hospital para evitar que siga buscando a Micaela y el dinero. Esperanza y Julián se reencuentran, lo que provoca que Micaela decida irse con Cabeto, aunque la policía los descubre. Julián se entera de la muerte de su mejor amiga, lo que le causa una gran tristeza.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Micaela llega a la casa de Elena, una Médica homeópata quien le ayuda a recordar el pasado. Por otra parte, Ricardo empieza a espiar a Mariana con un supuesto Escolta que promete protegerla. Finalmente, Esperanza le cuenta a Julián cómo ocurrieron las cosas el día que murió su esposo, sin embargo, le oculta que fue Micaela quien lo asesinó arrojándolo por las escaleras y no ella.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: El Teniente Morales sospecha de Ricardo por las llamadas a Patricia antes de su muerte. Julián intenta contactar a Micaela, pero ella prefiere quedarse con Elena. A pesar de su confianza en Ricardo, este le miente a Julián sobre Mariana.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Esperanza se reúne con Micaela, quien está alucinando por una droga. programme.title: Storm Hunters
programme.desc: The Stormhunters find themselves knee deep in flood waters as historic rainfall threatens to wash them away.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Definitely our wildest episode so far. Here’s the deal: Mt. Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker: High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion. For millennia elephants have been going into the cave to carve it out with their tusks in order to eat the salty rock. Here’s the second kicker: the cave is thought to be the home of the Ebola Marberg virus – the world’s most deadly virus. So here’s the plan: We are going enter the cave, at night, wearing full Bio-Hazard suits to protect us from the virus.

programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | Java - Land of Fire
programme.desc: Geoorge explores Java at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | By Camel to Timbuktu
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: LED LIFESTYLE
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: LED LIFESTYLE
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Jerónimo Best, actor y productor de teatro que ha llevado su carrera a escenarios nacionales e internacionales, incluyendo la Royal Shakespeare Company en Reino Unido. Jerónimo nos comparte sus inicios en el teatro, la emoción de pisar escenarios legendarios y cómo la actuación, en inglés y en español, transforma la manera de sentir y comunicar emociones. Además, Jerónimo reflexiona sobre su labor como productor, traductor y adaptador de proyectos teatrales, así como la importancia de crear equipos actorales que funcionen como una familia. Con humor, sensibilidad y mucha pasión por el oficio, Jerónimo nos invita a mirar el teatro como un espacio donde la ficción detiene el tiempo y nos recuerda el poder de las historias para emocionar, unir y transformar.
